weights: Exact represented GGUF decoded FP32 then exactly promoted FP64 in bounded tensor reads
dot_precision: CPU FP64; jax_enable_x64=True, matmul highest; no BF16/TF32
router: Google softmax and renormalization, exact lax.top_k descending with lower expert ID first on ties
gelu: Google flax.nn.gelu default approximate=True tanh architecture
rope: Canonical Google formula with exponent, phase, cosine and sine in FP64; infinite timescale leaves global half-pairs unrotated

qualification.fp32_operator_absolute_scale: 3e-5 * max(1, RMS expected) per operation; fail and investigate larger values
qualification.rationale: Empirical FP32 operator checks against independent FP64 calculations for dimensions up to 2816; not a rigorous full-model error bound
qualification.state_rationale: FP64 full/chunk/decode must agree within fixed1e-6; restore and reset repeats bitwise
qualification.rope_element_bound: (|first|+|second|) * 8*eps32*(|position/timescale|+1) + 2e-6 per component; includes position-conditioned mandatory FP32 frequency errors; empirical resolution gate not global rigorous pow bound
